title: File Review Projection Fixture
description: A persisted file_review ledger plus the expected file_change_sets projection summary, replayed identically by Go and Java.

phase.description: ExecutionPhase enum value name, e.g. EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS.

events.description: Ordered FileReviewEvent protojson objects (the persisted ledger).

expected.description: Expected projected FileChangeSet summaries, in projection order.

blocked_reasons.description: Optional: expected FileReviewBlockReason enum value name per change, aligned with change_ids order (doc 15). Asserted only when present, so it never forces every fixture to declare it.

acknowledged_change_ids.description: Optional: file_change_ids of decisions carrying acknowledge_unreviewable=true, in decision order (DD-16). Asserted only when present, proving the audit flag survives persist->project identically in Go and Java.
